entries.summary: inkling2: faster Metal decode, prefill and draft rounds; Add Inkling-only Metal kernels, each with a stock-graph fallback, gated; by GPU generation and size class: short BF16 products, deduplicated; NVFP4/MXFP8 expert…
entries.text: inkling2: faster Metal decode, prefill and draft rounds Add Inkling-only Metal kernels, each with a stock-graph fallback, gated by GPU generation and size class: short BF16 products, deduplicated NVFP4/MXFP8 expert gathers with fused SwiGLU, fused loop controllers and residual mixing, relative-position split attention, fused short convolutions, faster global prefill, an ordered window cache that appends in place, and an 8-bit draft with a 4-bit vocabulary head (proposals only; outputs stay exact).

entries.text: Inkling 2 Mini Inkling 2 Mini from Thinking Machines is a 26B parameter model with 5.4B active. Its looped layers give it more computation per token than its size suggests, and it still fits on a Mac at about 20GB. It handles text and images, tool calls, and thinking, and scores 79.2% on SWE-Bench Verified). ollama run inkling-2-mini Note: inkling-2-mini is supported on Apple silicon only in this release. PC support will follow in an upcoming release. What's Changed ollama launch claude supports Claude Code's deferred tool loading, so MCP tools are loaded when needed instead of all at once Ollama on Apple silicon now serves multiple requests at once. ollama launch opencode sets thinking options from the model's metadata ollama launch pi refreshes Pi's model list after sign-in and passes along prompt arguments ollama launch chatgpt --restore asks before switching an active profile and preserves existing settings and chat history; quitting ChatGPT yourself now lets it exit through its own quit prompt Running ollama with no arguments in a non-interactive shell prints help instead of erroring Ctrl+C or Ctrl+G while in a multiline """ block leaves multiline mode instead of swallowing the next line Changing the context shift setting no longer reloads the model Vulkan now uses mmap for integrated GPUs, fixing Failed to allocate pinned memory load failures on shared-memory GPUs On Windows iGPUs, partially offloaded models no longer fail to allocate the KV cache Tool definitions passe

entries.text: mlxrunner: adapt saved history to memory pressure Retain Metal prefix history using observed memory headroom and execution workspace rather than a fixed 8 GiB allowance. Release unused buffers and cold history when system compression grows, preserving reusable paths and active requests. Cover pressure reclamation, snapshot ownership, memory observation, and cacheless request isolation. address comments address comments

entries.text: mlxrunner: batch speculative verification Keep drafting active for concurrent generation by sharing target verification while preserving per-request sampling and cache rollback. Learn draft depth for each concurrent workload separately from isolated requests, and preserve probes that short requests never execute. Materialize owned target features before a reader can pause, and cover acceptance, cancellation, handoffs, mixed decoding and retained-memory boundaries. address comments
